name: log_line_prefix
description: A printf-style string prefixed to each PostgreSQL log line, with % escape sequences substituted by runtime values like timestamp, process ID, user, database, etc.
symptoms: Failure to parse logs in external tools (e.g., PgBadger)
Missing audit trail for user or database activity
Difficulty correlating log entries with client sessions
tuning_tips: Choose a prefix that includes sufficient identifiers (e.g., %m, %p, %u, %d, %a) for your observability and compliance needs; avoid excessive length or unsupported escapes to prevent parsing failures in log processors.
